en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with tall leafy trees, lawns and flowerbeds. A curved path runs in the foreground where a man in early‑20th‑century clothing and hat sits alone on a bench. In the mid‑ground are ornamental stone steps with a balustrade leading up toward large residential or institutional buildings partly hidden by trees. On the right stands a decorative, vertically layered stone monument or shrine with niches and figurative sculpture, surrounded by rocks and benches.
